links.comparator_used: General-purpose GPT-4o used zero-shot as the standard model, compared with the open-source medical model MedGemma on IDRiD and Messidor-2
links.outcome: Baseline diabetic retinopathy detection (sensitivity, AUROC, specificity)
links.effect: MedGemma had higher sensitivity and AUROC than GPT-4o. GPT-4o had near-perfect specificity but low sensitivity. The abstract gives no figures for this baseline comparison.
links.tradeoff: GPT-4o's near-perfect specificity came with low sensitivity. GPT-4o's performance also collapsed when given incorrect simulated AI inputs, while MedGemma stayed more stable.
links.quote: MedGemma outperformed GPT-4o at baseline, achieving higher sensitivity and AUROC, while GPT-4o showed near-perfect specificity but low sensitivity.

design_hint: AI output format (descriptive vs binary) in clinician-AI assistance
